title: Chemical epigenetic modification uncovers new isocoumarins from the endophyte Dothideomycetes sp. BMC-101
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29240-29248
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02544G, Paper

Yajuan Cong, Haotian Wang, Hong Wang, Jing Jiang, Lanying Li, Runyu Wu, Yixuan Zhang, Qiang Huo, Meilin Zhu
Four isocoumarins, including two enantiomer pairs [(±)-dothideomarins A (1a/1b) and B (2a/2b)] and two analogs C and D (3 and 4), were isolated from endophytic fungus Dothideomycetes sp. BMC-101 via OSMAC & MS/MS molecular networking.
